subject: Idea, Interfacing "frequentist statistic package" code from STAN

messages.author: 71c315ee557ff234
messages.subject: Idea, Interfacing "frequentist statistic package" code from STAN
parts:
Dear STAN team,

I see a lot of STAN users re-implementing solved problems in Bayesian way with STAN,
including myself. 

Would it be impossible in each iteration step to call a function from R or any other interface
using the input from the sampled values, take the output and use it for further processing
in STAN?

Benefits would be: 

- not re-implementing the wheel. 
- speed gain
- more focus of STAN users on the problem domain and do the standard "things" with
statistic package code.

Just some thoughts,
Andre
